The directivity is improved using graphene, and silicon as the substrate material, and can reach about 7.45 dBi for a thickness of 4.75 μm. The gain can then reach about 34 dBi at 0.1 THz. The gain and directivity could be improved over frequency by the implementation of an antenna array, which will be of great interest for future studies of the sixth generation of telecommunications (6G).

articleTitle: A Survey on Various Decoding Algorithms for McEliece Cryptosystem Based on QC-MDPC Codes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The McEliece cryptosystem has proven to be a secure and efficient method for protecting sensitive information in communication infrastructure. Among the variants of this cryptosystem, the quasi-cyclic moderate density parity-check (QC-MDPC) McEliece Cryptosystem has received significant attention due to its compact key size. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of the various decoding algorithms used for the QC-MDPC McEliece Cryptosystem. The performance and effectiveness of each algorithm in securing data in the face of quantum computing challenges is thoroughly evaluated. This survey provides valuable insights into the strengths and weaknesses of each decoding algorithm, and offers guidance for future research in the area of code-based cryptography for quantum computing.

articleTitle: Industrial Excellence in Morocco and LEAN tools: What relationship and what impact?
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Any industrial firm wishing to improve and dominate the market share must trace a certain approach to enhance the product or service marketed and link many tools and methods to ensure this production perfection. A study of a well-estimated duration allowed us to link each industrial concept with a well-specified statistic reflecting the degree of necessity to integrate this concept, whatever the sector or field of activity of this industrial firm is. A study sample that encompasses both sizes of firms. The aim is clear, to ignore or confirm the link between Lean and the term industrial excellence. Much information has been inserted within well-developed SmartPls and SPSS software. On the other hand, inserting Lean Manufacturing could give this way to excellence, because unfinished could cause a certain anomaly to the whole chain.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance Optimization of High-Speed Train Bearing Under Bayesian Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: A Bayesian-driven predictive maintenance planning model is proposed for high-speed train bearings. The nonlinear stochastic Wiener process with uncertain drift coefficient is employed to extract the non-monotonic health trends from real-time vibration signals. The degenerate parameters are estimated through the integration of offline estimation via Maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) and online updating under Bayesian framework. Then, the online distribution of asset lifetime is predicted by dynamic spatio-temporal scale transformation, which further supports dynamic sequential replacement decisions. The operational cost in terms of replacement decision variables is optimized, whose value is dynamically updated under Bayesian framework. The availability of the model is demonstrated by a practical case study on health management of high-speed train bearings.

articleTitle: Comparison of Turbulence Approaches Modelling the Flow Around the NACA 0012 Profile
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Turbulence refers to the instability of air movements in which the speed has a whirling character at all points. This is a phenomenon often observed and generates sometimes violent movements that can disrupt flight in the case of aerodynamic interactions with aircraft. Bodily accidents due to turbulence are numerous, but they can be avoided with good control and prediction of the fluid behavior around this structure. In order to do this, designers are increasingly using numerical modeling to boost these aircraft's efficiency. We carried out a numerical analysis of the two-dimensional transonic flow on a NACA 0012 airfoil using the ANSYS/FLUENT software in order to compare the capacity of different turbulence models to predict results that are similar to those of experimental studies. The results were compared to the provided experimental data in the high Reynolds Number range of 9.10<sup>6</sup>. Then, a comparison based on the RANS, LES and Hybrid approach in order to obtain a better control of the profile performance. We demonstrated that Spalart-Allmaras model of Dettached Eddy Simulation gave good results for unsteady flow over the wing.

articleTitle: A mathematical study of a combination of night radiative cooling and solar heating system in the subtropical climate
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In subtropical climates, the problem of the lack of studies concerning the parametric analysis of radiative cooling technology and its combination with solar heating draws attention. For this, in this work, both technologies have been examined using a radiative panel in three different climates in Morocco to classify meteorological parameters effects by analyzing the nightly, daily, and monthly performances. Therefore, a mathematical model capable of estimating night, day, and monthly thermal performances in different climates has been developed. It is based on the energy balance of each component of the radiative panel, the Runge-Kutta 4th order, and finite difference methods. Then, the developed model was experimentally validated. As a result, the highest cooling power is obtained in the hot semi-arid climate when the relative humidity is low than 52%, after this relative humidity, it becomes below that obtained in the hot arid climate which also presents the optimum heating performances. While low cooling and heating performances are obtained in the hot-summer Mediterranean climate. Consequently, the influence order of the meteorological parameters can be listed as; firstly the relative humidity, then, the air temperature and wind velocity.

articleTitle: Investigating the Performance of BERT Model for Sentiment Analysis on Moroccan News Comments
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is the field of determining the attitude or emotions expressed in text, which has become popular due to the rise of social media. AI, ML, and DL have greatly impacted the field of NLP and there have been efforts to improve the accuracy of sentiment analysis using linear models and deep neural networks. The analysis of emotions and feelings in Natural Language Processing is a fascinating area of research that aims to understand people's psychological state through their written opinions. Transformer-based models have been found to be highly effective in sentiment analysis and are currently the best option for many languages. However, sentiment analysis in Arabic still requires improvement, particularly in the tokenization stage. This article conducts a comparative study of various Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) models and found that MARBERT is the top performer in terms of classification quality and accuracy compared to other Arabic BERT models.

articleTitle: Design of a six-layer data architecture based on OT/IT convergence in the context of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: To support digital transition of industrial companies, it is imperative to prepare a strong technical infrastructure to implement cyber-physical systems, that should be a corner stone to build smart factory models. Our article has the target of proposing a key element of this imperative, by elaborating a data-driven architecture relying on automation of production lines, given that data should be placed at the center of digital manufacturing. Furthermore, the advent of Industry 4.0 technologies has imposed their integration into any modern architecture model, thanks to their ability to enhance the properties of real-time, mobility and connectivity. Thus, we have ensured that our multi-layer proposed model be hybrid in nature, combining both traditional technologies and those of Industry 4.0 generation, so that could serve digital mutations progressively, Also, the suggestion of this work has been fortified by resilient measures to face some serious challenges, such as: cybersecurity threats, agility in implementation, energy saving and investment optimization.

articleTitle: Problem-Oriented Medical Records for Describing Care Cases Using Multi-Tenants
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: There are countless applications in healthcare for digital personal assistants helping clinicians as well as patients and their families. However, there is no conversational application to understand patient encounters and assist clinicians to describe their clinical cases in association with their medical record like the HL7 FHIR. Building such conversational service requires understanding of the charting schema used to record clinical cases in the clinical setting like the SOAP note as well as having the federated APIs to exchange messages not only between tenants (e.g. Patients and Physicians) but also with different servers including the FHIR electronic healthcare record server. In this paper we described the extension that we have added to our existing QL4POMR framework to have extended ability to represent clinical cases via the use of multi-tenants chatbots based on the SOAP note and the connectivity to the FHIR server. The extension to the QL4POMR uses the Google DialogFlow and the GraphQL-Yoga APIs. This research work is a continuation of our MITACS and NSERC funded work that has started in 2020.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based MPPT Techniques in Wind Energy Systems: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The global opportunity to accelerate the world's renewable energy in future is technological progress. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is used to drive the fastest revolution in technology. Thus, the highest possible level of energy conversion efficiency is required for wind turbines in order to fully use wind power. This paper introduces an overview of AI-based Maximum-Power-Point- Tracking (MPPT) for wind energy systems (WES). Given that wind energy conversion systems (WECS) are becoming increasingly complex and unexpected changing in wind speed conditions. Indeed, working conditions have a major impact on yield. Achieving the ideal yield is typically difficult. For this reason, MPPT controllers are attracting a lot of attention. This review provides a thorough analysis of both Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Fuzzy Logic (FL) used in WES. And identifies the approaches used most frequently to provide the best possible yield in many situations. Both ANN and FL may be utilised instead of more traditional approaches for control and optimisation, for which the approaches are collected and analysed based on the application. Both techniques in this area and its potential developments are statistically presented. A thorough bibliography is done, ideas for further study are offered, and a number of difficulties have been risen. Ultimately, future research in wind generation systems should find this platform helpful to academics, energy planners, and politicians.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of FAPbI3 perovskite based solar cells with graphene oxide as hole transport layer using SCAPS-1D
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the present paper, we have realized a solar cell based on the perovskite formamidinium lead halide material FAPbI3. Using the SCAPS-1D simulator, we have calculated the various parameters of the cell such as open circuit voltage (Voc), short circuit current density (Jsc), fill factor (FF) and power conversion efficiency (PCE). The electrical properties of the FAPbI3 active layer were calculated. The effect of FAPbI<inf>3</inf> layer thickness, series and shunt resistances on photovoltaic parameters and the temperature on the solar cell (n-FTO/ n-Ti02/p-FAPbI3/p-GO (HTL)) were evaluated. Our simulation study on the FAPbI3 perovskite solar cell, allowed us to find the following values (Voc = 0.79 V, Jsc = 26.53 mA.cm-<sup>2</sup>, FF = 78.31 %, PCE = 16.55%). Our results are in good agreement with published experimental values and also simulated by SCAPS-1D. The presence of graphene oxide as a hole transport layer, allows the FAPbI3 cell a maximum energy conversion, according to simulation data.

articleTitle: Measuring and Identifying Appropriate Levels of Flexibility: A Novel Approach and Use Case in the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Manufacturing systems need to adapt to internal and external uncertainties, and flexibility is a crucial component to achieve this. Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing systems have made flexibility and reconfigurability essential pillars of modern manufacturing. Determining the appropriate level and type of flexibility can help reduce costs and enable systems to respond quickly. This paper explores various types of flexibility outlined in existing literature and proposes new types that can significantly impact the production system. To classify these flexibilities, a two-dimensional grid is presented that considers decision horizons (strategic, tactical, and operational levels) and physical dimensions of the system (resource, workshop, factory, and supply chain). A universal measurement method based on three criteria is also proposed to ensure that a measurement method is applicable to all types of flexibility. These criteria include the range of variation, response time, and the number of alternative solutions. Finally, a real case study is presented to illustrate the application of the proposed method. The case study involves the introduction of a new product in the automotive industry, and the obtained results are discussed.

articleTitle: Towards Secure Transactions with IoT: An Advanced Smart Payment Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Since the spread of the Corona virus, the financial sector has seen rapid growth in online stores and the use of credit cards has become increasingly popular. However, the banking industry is adversely affected by the phenomenon of online payment fraud which can have a significant impact on both customer trust and the reputation of the bank. Many customers around the world and Moroccan customers in particular, prefer to stay away from online or credit card payments by using traditional payment methods. Furthermore, cybercriminals and fraudulent activity are becoming more creative. According to recent studies, cumulative commercial losses from fraud worldwide between 2023 and 2027 will exceed $343 billion. Therefore, it is imperative to provide the necessary infrastructure for customers to make fast and secure financial transactions. To prevent fraud and boost customer confidence, banks should expand contactless payment options and offer new online payment methods. This article presents a method for making secure and fast online payments using the Internet of Things (IoT). The main objective is to improve bank quality and customer satisfaction by reducing waiting times and improving customer interaction during the payment process.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Clustering Based on Static Cluster to Maximize Lifetime in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) consist of a set of sensor nodes distributed in an area of interest used to detect the physical parameters of the environment One of the familiar methods that mainly focus on increasing the power factor in WSNs is clustering Current clustering approaches use two methods: dynamic clustering in which the formation of clusters occurs periodically in each round, or forming clusters that remain fixed during network operation using static clustering, However, the previous algorithms did not consider the energy consumed in the communication between nodes. In the paper, we propose an Energy Efficient Clustering (EEC) based on static clustering to solve the problems of energy consumption used in cluster formation These algorithms were implemented in MATLAB and were evaluated in terms of various performance metrics, such as energy efficiency and lifetime Simulation results have verified that the proposed method is better than the other existing approaches.

articleTitle: Evaluation of User Experience in Software Product Lines Derivation Process
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: In the past decades, it has beenincreasingly acknowledged that user's requirements go beyond usability, leadingto more general concept “the user experience”. Design and evaluation of userexperience proved a positive result in improving users satisfaction. In thecontext of software product lines, assessment of user experience is notavailable. This paper fills this gap by involving the evaluation of userexperience in the product derivation process. Building from pre-existing userexperience questionnaires, a generalized tool is proposed with a list of 14factors and 66 items. Software product line designer can use this tool toconceive an adequate questionnaire for his user depending on the product andthe context of use. By analyzing experiences in interacting with products,designers can better understand future customers and then reduce productiontime and effort.

articleTitle: Moroccan Industry Through the Lens of Energy Efficiency: Current Findings and Research Gaps
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The Moroccan industrial sector has considerable share in the total energy consumption of the country (22%). Furthermore, it is mainly based on fossil energy sources and thus responsible for 13% of national energy related CO<inf>2</inf> emissions. However, to bring this sector on the path of decarbonization, industrial energy efficiency is a key axis for this energy transition. The purpose of this article is to draw up the findings of scientific research in the field of energy efficiency in the Moroccan industry. To do this, 15 relevant articles have been systematically selected and analyzed to develop a four-dimensional classification scheme: energy audit, energy prediction, energy optimization and, energy efficiency drivers and barriers. Once this is accomplished, the gaps in this topic have been highlighted to open the way for future research issues. The main pointed out gaps are related to the lack of benchmarking tools, key performance indicators, energy efficient production planning and, machine learning models.

articleTitle: Integrating elevation and bathymetric data in GIS for a continuous 3D model of Ischia Island and surrounding seabed
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: 3D models, particularly useful in many technical and scientific applications, can be easily created starting from cartographic data, using the tools provided by Geographic Information Systems (GIS). If you want to create a 3D model concerning both the territory and the marine areas adj acent to it, the necessary cartographic data are often present in different documentary sources. This requires some preliminary operations in order to homogenize these data, bringing them to the same cartographic datum, proj ection and scale of representation. This article aims to define an efficient procedure for the construction of a 3D model of Ischia Island and the surrounding seabed at medium scale. For the territorial part, a Digital Elevation Model (DEM) with a resolution of 2 meters is used. For the bathymetric part, the data is taken from an Electronic Navigational Chart (ENC) at a scale of 1:30,000. The two types of data differ both in the detail of information and in the altimetric datum. The territorial data is processed in order to have the elevation information at the same scale of representation as the nautical chart. The bathymetric data is traced back to the same altimetric datum of the DEM. The elevation and depth data, reported at the same projection (Universal Transverse of Mercator, UTM) and datum (WGS84), are interpolated by Ordinary Kriging imposing a resolution of 15 meters. The verifications of the level of accuracy through Cross-validation confirm the validity of the procedure performed and the quality of the model obtained.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Transportation of Students with Disabilities on Campus
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Access to education has always been aconstitutional right provided by countries to their citizens. To fosterinclusion and equality, many countries have made tangible efforts recently toinclude students with disabilities in mainstream education. A recentministerial resolution by the UAE government directs education institutions tocater to the needs of students with disabilities. Moving comfortably, andefficiently on campus is a basic need for students to attend lectures, labsessions, and social activities in different buildings. However, this basicneed forms another major challenge for students with disabilities. Thischallenge is usually aggravated in gated campuses where private cars are notallowed. In such situations, students with disabilities rely on the specialtransportation service provided by the education institution to move on campus.However, this service is ad-hoc in nature and requires students to communicatewith the service center to book the service in advance. The service booking isdone manually, which reduces the utilization of the available vehicles, andincreases the students' waiting time and the possibility that the booking isrejected. This paper introduces a mobile application with an intelligentbooking system to automate the booking requests. The aim of the system isreducing the students' wait time and booking rejection rate while maximizingthe utilization of the available vehicles.

articleTitle: Deep reinforcement learning strategy in automated trading systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Every day, a considerable amount of money is traded in the form of derivatives in global financial markets. Artificial intelligence (AI) software is now the main competitor of traditional investors; it allows market players to anticipate price variations. Adopting a strategy in the stock market using machine learning is essential to make a profit when the markets are depressed. Thus, this study proposes a new approach to train the model of an intelligent trading agent based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL), highlighting the dilemma of the exploitation and exploration phase during the training model as well as its impact on the model performance on a separate or combined portfolio asset. This study shows a clear improvement by backtesting a portfolio composed of three stock market indices, illustrating the advantages and gains obtained by deep reinforcement learning strategy in financial markets.

articleTitle: Automatic coastline extraction from Landsat 9 satellite images and raster maps
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Due to its dynamic nature, coastline requires a continuous monitoring action, especially in presence of natural phenomena such as erosion and sea level rise. Earth observation from space is definitely useful for monitoring coastline variations, particularly in areas that are difficult to access. In addition to satellite images, other sources of information are maps that are very useful to support studies aimed at reconstructing the dynamics underway starting from periods even prior to remote sensing from space. This article aims to define a new methodological approach to automate the process of extracting the coastline, both from maps and satellite images, so as to eliminate the human error related to photointerpretation and manual vectorization. Experiments are carried out on Landsat 9 satellite images with cell resolution 30 m concerning the North-West of Campania Region and two raster maps in scale 1:25,000 included in the same area. The layer resulting from the application of Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) to the satellite dataset is submitted to K-means algorithm for distinguishing land and sea. The coastline is automatically extracted as separation between those two classes. The same unsupervised process is applied to the raster maps with the same objective. Tests on the accuracy of the resulting coastlines confirm the quality of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Conceptualization and Configuration of a Generic SCM 4.0 Business Process Model Using BPMN Based on SCOR
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Systems modeling is a crucial step that comes before performance evaluation. Moreover, it allows us to better understand the company's flows, either to help in decision-making or to improve its Manufacturing Planning. In the context of Supply Chain Management 4.0 (SCM 4.0), we have chosen modeling tools that allow us to describe the main processes of the Supply Chain (SC), in order to define the needs in terms of performance evaluation, taking into account the static and dynamic specificities linked to the uncertainty of the environment and the digitalization. In fact, the static model describes structural characteristics whereas the dynamic model describes dynamic behavior. The modeling improvement process requires static and dynamic sub-models developed from identical concepts and whose coherence is ensured by interactions between the two models. In our research work, we propose a Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) used to convert the natural language of SC processes into process diagrams with graphical elements. We use tasks and sub-processes are used to depict basic SC plans and functions. Sequence flows to connect activities and present the transitions and path of tasks and plans. We also use Gateways to control the convergence and divergence of paths in SC process diagrams. Message flows display information flows and material flows between SC entities as needed. Thus, we develop a static and dynamic model that represents the SC using a generic modeling approach based on Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) and BPMN.

articleTitle: Maintenance Optimization of Multi-Component Systems Subjected to $s$-Dependent Competing Risks and Imperfect Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: This paper develops a novelreliability-based maintenance optimization approach in multi-componentsrepairable system (MCRS) subjected to both <tex>$s$</tex>-dependent competing risks andimperfect maintenance. The system operates a sequence of preventive maintenance(PM) cycles at the end of which a preventive replacement of the system iscarried out. Duration of each PM cycle is determined by a reliability thresholdwhich triggers either an imperfect PM or a preventive replacement; there are asmuch PM cycles as reliability thresholds. The objective of the proposedmaintenance approach is to determine the joint optimal reliability thresholdsand the number of PM cycles that minimize the total expected maintenance andbreakdown cost rate in the infinite time horizon. Conditions to derive optimalsolutions are formally established and discussed. Given the complexity of theresulting optimization problem, a fix-and-optimize numerical algorithm usingthe gradient descent method is developed. The numerical results obtained fromthe case study demonstrate the accuracy and the added value of the proposedapproach. These results clearly show that it is not only cost-effective butalso adaptive and allow then to increase the system availability. Indeed,except for the last PM cycle, it is shown that the optimal reliabilitythreshold increases by the increasing of the number of PM cycles.

articleTitle: Vibration Modeling Of A Bimorph Functional Graded Piezoelectric Energy Harvester Based On The Timoshenko Beam Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The goal of this work is the modelization of a clamped-free bimorph Functionally Graded Piezoelectric Energy Harvester (FGPEH) subjected to an electrical voltage. The FGPEH is composed of a mixture of two different materials: ceramic alumina and of aluminum sandwiched by two identical piezoelectric layers. These two layers represent piezoelectric actuators, which are symmetrically and perfectly bonded to the top and bottom surfaces of the FGM substrate layer. The FGPEH is modeled by a rectangular Timoshenko beam considering the physical axis instead of the neutral axis. The position of the physical axis has been determined. Only geometric and material linearities are considered in this study. Power law relations are used to obtain the constituent effective material properties. The lagrangian formalism is adopted to establish the free vibration governing equations of the functionally graded piezoelectric beam. The eigenfrequencies and eigenmodes of the bimorph functionally graded piezoelectric beam are computed analytically. This study showed that there is a critical frequency that delimits two distinct vibratory behaviors. For frequencies below (resp above) the critical frequency there is a generation of two (resp four) traveling waves. The effects of pulsation, volume fraction index, and location of the physical axis on the eigenmodes are also examined.

articleTitle: Numerical study of a new ecological material in moroccan climate: CFD approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The thermal insulation of buildings based on ecological materials resets the excellent solution to decrease the impact of inorganic materials on the environment, using materials of biological origins, such as Durian, Bagasse, Date Palm, Pineapple Leaves, Wood fibers, etc. With their low intrinsic energy, they can improve the quality of the environment and the thermal and energetic performance of the building; for this reason, a comparative study is made numerically using a method of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) two-dimensional between a wall without insulation and a wall with insulation based on an ecological coating based on Aerosil, in the Moroccan climate, and precisely in the city of Ifrane which characters by a cold climate, the solution presented efficient energy savings during both winter and summer season. The results showed that the configuration with the insulation generates an energy saving of 14% during the winter and 61.1% during the summer. The interior surface temperature was reduced by about 4 °C during summer days and increased by about 2 °C during winter. The effect of thickness on energy sheathing increased from 61.1% to 88.2% during summer and from 14% to 47% during winter.

articleTitle: Assistive Control System of Appliances through Gaze Point Eye Tracker with Integrated Graphical User Interface for Bedridden Person
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: Persons with Disabilities (PWD), specifically, the bedridden person incapable of controlling certain appliances or devices to continue with their daily life which they struggle with. The need for assistive technology arises nowadays, for which artificial intelligence has become valuable and prominent. The implementation of different pattern recognition algorithms is applied to various applications. This paper discusses using the Tobii Eye tracker algorithm to control the appliances with an Arduino with an infrared emitter and relays. In this paper, the measurement of the system response time as a variable leads the parameter of such different calculations. The sample of data was collected at varying head angles of inclination with also varying distances relative to the monitor. The P-values gathered were 0.11947, 0.287368, and 0.120036 at distances of 30 cm, 40cm, and 60 cm, respectively. From the data, it is found that at a level of significance of 0.05, which indicates the system is accurate, leading to not rejecting the null hypothesis that there is a variance in the mean of samples.

articleTitle: Improved Mapping of Paddy Rice Extent Using Deep Learning and Time Series Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET)
abstract: The agricultural sector has benefited enormously from technological advances, and progress is far to come to its end. For instance, Improvements in machine learning and deep learning algorithms over the last few decades have increased the power of computer analysis and geospatial techniques, making agricultural management more accurate and reliable for making sound decisions. This study aims to analyze the performance of artificial neural networks, along with high-resolution satellite imagery and Google Earth Engine, to make inferences about rice culture extent. Time series of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index were employed to characterize the phenological cycle of paddy rice. Nevertheless, different imperfections are inherent to time series due to: the irregularity of satellite acquisitions, the missing data caused by masking clouds, and atmospheric disturbances. The time series is then subjected to several processes to overcome its imperfections, before feeding it to the employed deep learning model for mapping rice extent.

abstract: The third International Conference on Innovative Research in Applied Science, Engineering and Technology (IRASET'2023) was held in ENSET Mohammedia, University Hassan II, Morocco, on May 18th and 19th, 2023.
